research_rationale: EO 13778 (signed 2017-02-28, 82 FR 12497-12498), read in full from the held FR text, directs the EPA Administrator and the Assistant Secretary of the Army for Civil Works to review the 2015 'Waters of the United States' rule and propose rescinding or revising it (sec. 2), consider the Scalia definition of navigable waters (sec. 3) and carries general provisions (sec. 4). It has no term, sunset or termination clause; the machine own-term hits are only 'implemented consistent with applicable law and subject to the availability of appropriations' and the OMB non-impairment sentence, which are conditions, not ends. EO 13990 (86 FR 7037-7043, read in full; reading record scale/readings/LSP-EO_13990.json) sec. 7(a) revokes it, effective on signing, 2021-01-20. Dossier lead 'target provision not located: EO:13790' resolved: EO 13790 (82 FR 20237, held FR text, read in full) sec. 4(c) only tells the new Interagency Task Force on Agriculture and Rural Prosperity to 'coordinate its efforts with other reviews of regulations or policy, including those conducted pursuant to' EO 13778; it does not revoke, amend, suspend or extend any provision of EO 13778, so it is ruled out and nothing is attached. A by-number scan of all 6,652 held FR-original texts finds EO 13778 named only in EO 13790 and EO 13990. EO 14148 and EO 14154 (2025) revoke EO 13990 but name none of the six orders and reinstate nothing. Inventory: the dossier's 10 clauses cover the operative text from sec. 1 through sec. 4(c); the unnumbered authority preamble is not a separate operative clause.
